llmEvalConfig.dataInterpretationPrompt: You are evaluating a sprint planning AI agent that edits a SharedTree data structure. The input contains the initial state of a sprint board (with work items and team members) and a natural language instruction. The output is the resulting sprint board state after the agent processed the instruction. Work items have fields: title, description, status (todo/in-progress/in-review/done), priority (critical/high/medium/low), assignee, storyPoints, and created timestamp. Team members have name and capacity fields.

rubrics.name: Task Completion
rubrics.description: Did the agent correctly execute the requested operation? Count the specific requirements in the instruction and verify each one is reflected in the output tree state.

rubrics.name: Data Integrity
rubrics.description: Are all pre-existing work items and team members preserved correctly? Check that items not mentioned in the instruction are unchanged. Verify no data was lost or corrupted.

rubrics.name: Content Quality
rubrics.description: Are the values set by the agent reasonable and appropriate? Check that status values, priorities, assignees, and story points make sense in context.
